title: Paul and Barnabas Return to Antioch
description: After preaching the gospel in Derbe and winning many disciples, Paul and Barnabas return through Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch in Pisidia. They strengthen the disciples, encourage them to remain firm in the faith, and appoint elders in each church with prayer and fasting. Through Pisidia, Pamphylia, Perga, and Attalia, they sail back to Antioch, where they gather the church and report all that God had done, and how he had opened the door of faith to the Gentiles.
